display_long_description:
Proton Pass is the secure, open-source password manager built by the team behind Proton Mail and Proton VPN. Protected by Swiss privacy laws and end-to-end encryption, Pass keeps your identity safe without ads, tracking, or data collection.

Create and store unlimited passwords across all your devices, autofill logins instantly, and generate strong passwords and 2FA codes. Protect your real email address with Proton’s Hide-My-Email aliases, helping you stay private whenever you sign up for new accounts.

Proton Pass includes secure vaults for organizing and sharing passwords, credit cards, and notes with trusted contacts. All shared data stays fully encrypted, and you can revoke access at any time. Built-in Pass Monitor helps you find weak or reused passwords, alerts you to data breaches, and highlights accounts missing 2FA.

Enhance your security with biometric unlock, custom PIN protection, and Proton Sentinel for advanced defense against account-takeover attacks. Access your data even offline, keep track of edits with item history, and quickly find what you need with Spotlight Search and bookmarks.

Proton Pass is fully open source, allowing anyone to verify its security. You can easily import data from other password managers or CSV files, making setup simple. With Proton Pass, you retain full control of your sensitive information—private, encrypted, and always accessible.
